title: BIS Industries Ltd - proposed acquisition of Gulf Transport Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of a national market for the supply of off-road haulage services to the mining industry.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition due to: - the significant number of rival haulage companies remaining post-acquisition - the ability of mining companies, to some extent, to conduct haulage operations themselves rather than outsourcing these services to haulage companies
